text:
maria_cs: quick health check on CrescendoAI — usage steady (~120k tokens/day), p95 latency creeping to 420ms on peak hours, exec flagged cost sensitivity ahead of renewal. thinking proactive ops: propose a short canary to 4-bit quantized variant + route non-interactive batch jobs to a cheaper model variant. feedback welcome :thinking_face:

raj_sre: can you drop exact p95 window and current model id? curious if this is KV cache miss pattern or just tail latency on concurrency spikes.

maria_cs: sure — p95 measured 12:00-14:00 PST last Wed/Thu. current model: rwd/gpt-large-v1. Concurrency spikes ~60 req/s, median seq len ~240 tokens. cache hit ~78%.

jake_ml: +1 for quant canary. 4-bit QAT gave us ~2.6x speedup on similar seq lengths but watch for hallucination bump on long contexts. would recommend: 1) canary 10% traffic to rwd/gpt-large-v1-q4f, 2) route low-priority async jobs to rwd/gpt-medium-eco for batching.

maria_cs: thx. customer accepts conservative testing. can we propose config they can sign off on for a 2-week canary + rollback policy?

raj_sre: I can spin the canary. sample routing rule we use:
```json
{
  "name": "crescendo-low-priority-route",
  "match": { "metadata.priority": "low" },
  "target": "rwd/gpt-medium-eco",
  "policy": { "batching": { "max_batch_size": 64, "wait_ms": 8 } }
}
```

raj_sre: for canary, I'll do gradual ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 48h with auto-revert on +5% latency or -1.5% quality (measured via eval set).

olivia_pm: capture renewal signal: client asked for a meeting if we hit >450ms p95 again. avoid that. suggest adding a preemptive alert to their console and offering an enablement session on prompt engineering to reduce ctx length.

maria_cs: noted. I'll schedule a quick enablement workshop. also capturing customer feedback: they prefer deterministic answers for financial summarization. Jake, can you add a prompt-eval pair to the regression set?

jake_ml: done — added 18 prompts from their sample corpus under cres_demo_set_v1. We'll track QA delta during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: canary_id=crescendo-q4-canary-202403; ramp schedule: 2% (0-6h), 10% (6-24h), 25% (24-48h). Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and Crescendo contacts.

maria_cs: perfect. next steps: 1) customer sign-off on canary config (I will send email with bullet points), 2) enablement session tentatively Wed 11am PST, 3) track p95 / eval delta daily and decide on full swap after 2 weeks if no regressions. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

raj_sre: will monitor and post metrics (p50/p95/p99, cache-hit, rejection rate). tag me if rollback triggers.

olivia_pm: I'll prepare renewal note highlighting proactive ops and risk mitigation — good signal for the account team.

maria_cs: thanks team. capturing customer comment for records: "appreciate the proactive test — priority is consistent latency under load, willing to try conservative canary."

maria_cs: end thread — will update after first ramp step.
